title: Cross-region model intelligence fusion and rapid recon playbook
creator: Sofia Ramos
description: Goal: produce a repeatable, low-effort playbook and lightweight tooling to fuse model capability signals across regions (NA / EU / APAC), prioritize candidate fallback models per customer cohort, and produce procurement-ready evidence packs for enterprise engagements. The deliverable should reduce time-to-confidence for model substitution recommendations from ~3 weeks to <= 4 business days for Tier-1 prospects.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Playbook doc (Confluence) with clear inputs, scoring rubric, and escalation paths published
A2: Recon harness (GitHub repo) that runs standardized probes across 3 regions and outputs a normalized CSV
A3: Two enterprise evidence packs created (one NA fintech, one EU healthcare) with latency/cost/fallback recommendations
A4: Hand-off workshop with Solutions and Sales recorded and checklist accepted
updates: 2026-02-20: Ticket created during product sync; scoped as a 2-sprint initiative to address customer RFP friction when model availability changes.

2026-02-22: Kickoff workshop with Research (Anika Patel), Infra (Marco Chen), and Solutions (Priya Desai). Agreed to an MVP that focuses on latency-sensitive embeddings and small-context generation probes.
2026-02-27: Engineering asked for a lean probe harness instead of full eval suite to keep runtime costs low — accepted. Action: ENG to provide sample inference logs by 2026-03-03.

2026-03-03: Received anonymized inference logs from ENG-ops; initial sampling script validated sequence-length distribution assumptions. Linking dataset: https://drive.redwood.design/shared/inference-samples-2026-02

2026-03-05: Draft scoring rubric posted to Confluence: includes dimensions (latency p50/p95, token-cost delta, semantic drift score, fallback surface compatibility). Feedback requested from Reliability team.
2026-03-09: Reliability-led review: recommended adding 'quantization compatibility' and 'model-variant churn risk' as secondary signals. Updated rubric accordingly.
2026-03-11: Created GitHub repo for recon harness and initial CI job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/recon-harness/pull/4 — runs small probes in us-west1, europe-west1, and asia-southeast1.

2026-03-12: Produced first regional CSV outputs and preliminary heatmap (private dashboard): https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/market-intel/recon-heatmap — shows a 20% p95 latency spike in APAC for model X-7B-quant.
2026-03-14: PM review: prioritized two tasks before hand-off — (1) normalize semantic drift scoring for short prompts, (2) add cost-per-1k-tokens column; assigned to ENG-4578 and RESEARCH-212.
Planned 2026-03-18: Live demo for Solutions + Sales; collect runbook feedback and finalize evidence pack template.
decision_log: D2026-02-22: Opted for a lightweight, repeatable probing harness vs. full eval suite to optimize for speed and cost during sales cycles.
D2026-02-27: Use normalized CSV + simple rubric for initial sorting; defer heavy NLU scoring to a follow-up project.
D2026-03-05: Include quantization compatibility and variant churn risk as signals to better reflect Dedicated/Private deployments.
D2026-03-11: Run probes from 3 regions only for MVP; expand to additional zones in post-MVP phase.
D2026-03-14: Evidence pack template will include a short 'operator playbook' for customers to reproduce probes in a VPC/private deployment.
next_steps: Add cost-per-1k-tokens normalization to CSV and rerun aggregated reports (owner: ENG-4578; due: 2026-03-17)
Finalize Confluence playbook and publish internal link (owner: Sofia Ramos; due: 2026-03-18)
Run two targeted recon runs for NA fintech and EU healthcare stacks and assemble evidence packs (owner: Liam O'Connor; due: 2026-03-24)
Schedule hand-off workshop with Solutions + Sales and record session (owner: Priya Desai; due: 2026-03-25)
